reasons: CS4215 is offered only in Sem 2, but the student requires it before CS2100. CS2100 requires a programming prerequisite (e.g. CS1010) which must be taken first. The earliest CS2100 can be taken is Sem 2 (if CS1010 is taken in Sem 1). However, CS4215 requires CS2040/CS2030/CS2113 prerequisites. CS2040 requires CS1010. So CS1010 (Sem 1) -> CS2040 (Sem 2) -> CS4215 (Sem 2 or later). If CS4215 is taken in Sem 2, CS2100 must be later. But CS2100 is offered Sem 1 and 2. If CS2100 is taken in Sem 2, it is not after CS4215 (same semester). The constraint 'CS4215 must come before CS2100' implies strict ordering. If CS4215 is Sem 2, CS2100 must be Sem 3+. But CS2100 is offered Sem 1 and 2. It is NOT offered in Sem 3 (Y2S1). Thus CS2100 cannot be taken after CS4215 if CS4215 is in Sem 2. If CS4215 is later, CS2100 must be even later, but CS2100 is not offered in Sem 3+. Therefore, no valid schedule exists.
